articles.title: Is AI making us dumber? Depends how it’s used
articles.snippet: AI can weaken learning when it replaces effort. But tools that offer guidance rather than answers can help people hone their skills.
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence can weaken learning when it replaces effort. However, tools that offer guidance instead of direct answers can help people improve their skills.
